stem.text: Two of the requirements of an efficient gas exchange system are a large surface area and a short diffusion distance.
Which row correctly describes how alveoli are adapted to meet these requirements?

A.text: elastin fibres prevent the alveolus wall from collapsing; an extracellular layer inside the alveolus wall contains blood capillaries

B.text: gases dissolve in a layer of liquid to speed up diffusion; alveolar walls are next to capillaries

C.text: alveoli are folded and interconnected; walls of alveoli are only one cell thick

D.text: walls of alveoli are formed of squamous epithelial cells; red blood cells are very close to capillary walls
